tc.research_text.technom:ADVDECONTABLE: When taking a good look just isn't enough.
tc.research_text.technom:ELECTRICBELLOWS: Bellows, but you do not have to pull them.
tc.research_text.technom:FLUXLAMP: Making a dangerous ritual a little less dangerous.
tc.research_text.technom:DYNAMO: Making magic energy out of magic energy.
tc.research_text.technom:PROCESSOR: Because Thaumcraft can't do it right.
tc.research_text.technom:TECHNOTURGESCEP: The right tool for every job!
tc.research_text.technom:TESLACOIL: The only reason you downloaded this mod.
technom.fusor.not_empty: Empty this fusor before changing it
technom.research_page.ADVDECONTABLE.1: The Advanced Deconstruction Table breaks an object down into pure primal knowledge. Place an object on it and it slowly grinds it apart; every so often the process yields one point of a primal aspect directly into your research pool, chosen from the primals that object was made of. The rarer the object, the longer it lasts. Install a Potency Gem with a shift-right-click to halve the time it takes; shift-right-click with an empty hand to take the gem back.
technom.research_page.BIOMEMORPHER.1: A machine that rewrites the land itself. Feed the Biome Morpher energy and it will slowly convert the biome around it, one column at a time, choosing its target at random within roughly a hundred blocks. Right-click the block to step through the three targets: Magical Forest, Eerie, and Tainted Land.
technom.research_page.ELECTRICBELLOWS.1: Why crank a bellows by hand? Place the Electric Bellows against the furnace it should blow into - it reaches an alchemical furnace one or two blocks away, or any ordinary furnace one block away - and it will keep that furnace stoked for as long as you keep it powered. One charge lights it; the bellows then pushes the cooking along exactly as a hand-cranked one would.
technom.research_page.FLUXLAMP.1: Infusion is unstable work. Set a Flux Lamp near an infusion altar and feed it ordo: while the altar is idle, the lamp draws the instability out of it, five points at a time, and drains it away as flux goo. Pipe the goo out before the lamp's tank fills, or the lamp simply stops calming anything.
technom.research_page.CONDENSER.1: Too much power is never a bad thing, and now you've got a machine to put it to good use. By hooking up an Energy Condenser to some conduits, you can turn Forge Energy (Q) into some Potentia. The Potentia can then easily be piped out of the condenser into your favorite jar. The energy cost of one Potentia is set by the condenserCostQ config value (200,000 Q by default).
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.1: After studying the way the Arcane Bore and Infernal Furnace draw essentia for power, you've decided to make your own spinoff using Forge Energy. By hooking the Essentia Dynamo to a series of pipes and wires, you can take essentia and turn it into Forge Energy (Q). Some aspects carry more energy than others and last longer, producing more power. How the Essentia Dynamo answers a redstone signal can be reconfigured in place.
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.2: Right clicking on the Dynamo with a Redstone Torch will cause the Dynamo to be disabled by a redstone signal, Gunpowder will make it ignore redstone, and Redstone Dust will return it to its original behavior. The dynamo can be rotated using most wrenches.
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.4: You have also discovered that Dynamos can have their power output increased at the cost of fuel consumption. By right clicking on the Dynamo with a Potency Gem, the Dynamo will output four times the power, but will also consume four times the fuel. Shift Right clicking on the Dynamo with an empty hand will remove the Potency Gem.
technom.research_page.ELDRITCHCONSUMER.1: The Eldritch Consumer is a hungry pit. Put it above a drop, a mob farm or an ore vein and feed it Forge Energy: each item, mob or block it destroys costs one charge and leaves behind the aspect that object was made of, which tubes and jars can pull out. Sneak-click it to step through its six working volumes, from a one-block pit to a 33x33 hole that reaches bedrock. It will not touch unbreakable blocks or anything holding a block entity, and a block it breaks yields its aspect but not its drops.
technom.research_page.ESSENTIAFUSOR.1: While breaking Essentia down into its components is useful, you have been searching for a way to reverse the process in the hopes of creating some of the more hard to find Essentia. Combining the Alchemical Centirfuge with some magic infused technology has finally provided the answer, the Essentia Fusor. The Fusor can be "programmed" with an Essentia recipe, and when provided with Essentia and power will create compound Essentia. To program the Fusor, right-click on two of the red points on the top of the Fusor with filled Essentia Phials that contain the Essentia types you wish to combine. Essentia that can not be combined will not be accepted.
technom.research_page.ESSENTIAFUSOR.2: Marking a side in this way will allow Essentia of that type to be accepted by that side. To mark the side to output the new Essentia to, right-click on another point with an empty Phial. Only two input sides and one output side can be marked at a time. If done correctly, the symbol for the desired Essentia should appear in the center of the Fusor. To remove a Phial from the Fusor, just right-click on it with an empty hand. Note that if the Fusor contains any Essentia of that type, or any Essentia of the output type, you will not be able to remove the Phial until the excess Essentia has been removed. By default the Fusor requires a redstone signal to operate, but this behavior can be modified in a way similar to the Dynamos.
technom.research_page.FUSIONFOCUS.1: A wand focus that treats a node as something you can pour. Use it on an aura node or a jarred node and the focus remembers it - that costs nothing. Use it on a second node and the first one's vis, and the capacity that holds it, are moved into the second in a single transaction, for 30 vis of every primal. Whatever does not fit stays behind, and a source that gives everything away is left as nothing at all.
technom.research_page.FUSIONFOCUS.2: Creating a node out of nothing is beyond this version: Thaumcraft's public node interface can only change nodes that already exist, so the focus moves vis between them instead of conjuring a new one. The selection is kept on the wand that carries the focus, so two thaumaturges never share one.
technom.research_page.NODEDYNAMO.1: Continuing your research into magical energy, you have realised that the vis of a node is not unlike the essentia held in items. A Node Dynamo drains one vis at a time from aura nodes and jarred nodes within four blocks, never taking the last point of an aspect, and burns it into Forge Energy through its output face. Its redstone behaviour, potency gem and rotation work exactly as on the Essentia Dynamo.
technom.research_page.NODEFABRICATOR.1: Converting magic to energy is easy enough, but the other way around is far more difficult and expensive.<LINE>Construction: two Fabricators need five blocks of space between them and must face each other. Each one builds an invisible 1x3x3 frame around itself; anything solid in the way simply leaves the frame unbuilt.<LINE>Essentia: Fabricators draw essentia through any face of that frame except the one they look through, from jars and tubes whose suction is lower than their own - which is why an unlabelled jar gives and a labelled jar of a different aspect does not.
technom.research_page.NODEFABRICATOR.2: Recharging a node: the node belongs one block above ground level, centred between the two Fabricators. Each 1000 Q and one unit of essentia puts one vis back into an aspect the node already has, never past its maximum.<LINE>Adding aspects to a node: with a potency gem installed, 10000 Q and ten units raise an aspect's maximum by one and fill that point, which is also how an aspect the node never had is introduced.
technom.research_page.NODEFABRICATOR.3: Node creation is not available in this version. Thaumcraft's public node interface can only change a node that already exists, so the wand-triggered ritual that used to build one out of aurum and vitium - and the essentia intake that fed it - are deliberately absent rather than half-working.
technom.research_page.PEN.1: Do you realize how stupid you are to use an ink and quill all this time? I mean, you've got frickin' wands that shoot frickin' lightning bolts and machines that make energy out of MAGIC for Pete's sake. Has it seriously taken you this long just to make a pen? The answer is yes, yes it has. But now you have a pen to use instead of that stupid inkwell: 3000 uses of ink, and clicking one of two adjacent tables with it builds the research table.
technom.research_page.PROCESSOR.1: You've been hunting down a way to increase your ore output without using silly purification methods, and now you've found one. By placing blocks in the left slot and adding Ignis essentia, you've successfully acquired ore doubling through purification. These new purified ores can be processed through other magical devices similar to this one to increase ore output further, but each device can only purify an ore twice. To obtain the ingots after the ore has been processed as many times as desired, throw the purified ore into a furnace in order to cook it.
technom.research_page.QUANTUMJARS.1: You have discovered a way to use the power of the almighty science to cram more essentia into a jar. This new jar uses quantum mechanics to increase its maximum storage capacity and therefore can be a bit unstable. The quantum jar is a bit more intelligent and has a higher suction rate than unlabeled warded jars and its suction increases depending on the amount of essentia within it.
technom.research_page.ROD_electric.1: Infusing a normal silverwood wand core with some energy and machines gives it special properties at the cost of its vis storage. With any Forge Energy battery in your inventory, the wand draws energy from it to refill its own vis storage at 100 Q per centivis, that is 10000 Q for one whole vis of a primal aspect. This wand can store 25 vis of each primal.
technom.research_page.TECHNOBASICS.1: After a series of scientific discoveries, you've figured out ways to incorporate your pre-existing electronics into your new magical discoveries unlocking some new basic materials.
technom.research_page.TECHNOTURGESCEPTER: After struggling with the low storage of the Energized Wand, you have started experimenting with ways to increase this capacity. No matter what you try, you always end up with a rod which is too big for normal use as a wand. But now that you have mastered scepters, you realise these failed experiments would make a perfect scepter core! The Technoturges Scepter holds 150 vis of each primal and recharges from a wand recharge pedestal or from any Forge Energy source, at 100 Q per centivis.

Assembly is Thaumcraft's own scepter recipe: three identical wand caps, a thaumic charm and the Technoturges core, which also means it needs the Scepters research. The scepter counts as a wrench on Technomancy machines; the 1.7.10 version's wrench support for other mods and its block-rotation gestures are not part of this port.
technom.research_page.TESLACOIL.1: After realizing how poorly essentia tubes work, you decide to switch over to a new wireless method that is much more refined. Use a Coil Coupler on an Essentia Coil, then on any jar or other essentia store, to link the coil to it. Once linked, the coil draws from its sources into whatever it is attached to until that is full. A coil holds up to 16 links, each within 32 blocks of it, and a source may feed any number of coils. Click a linked source again to unlink it, or sneak-click the coil with the coupler to clear every link. Apply a printed jar label to filter the coil to one aspect; sneak-click it with an empty hand to take the label back.
technom.research_page.TESLACOIL.2: The coil does not only push. Machines that pull essentia for themselves, such as the Thaumatorium, the Arcane Bore or an Arcane Lamp, can draw straight from a coil placed against them as if it were a tube, and the coil fetches whatever they ask for from its linked sources. An Essentia Buffer between coil and machine remains a safe interface for anything that neither accepts pushed essentia nor pulls it on its own.
technom.research_page.TESLACOIL.3: A coil only works while it receives no redstone signal; program it with redstone, a redstone torch or gunpowder like other machines. Install a Potency Gem and the coil instead emits a redstone signal while the block it feeds still has room, ignoring redstone itself. Sneak-click it with an empty hand to take the gem back once the label is gone.

technom.lexicon.category.desc: Machines that couple Botania's mana to Forge Energy.
technom.lexicon.techno_basics.1: The first step is to put mana into iron. Drop redstone into a mana pool and infuse it to make a Mana Coil, then wrap a Mana Coil around an iron ingot with Manasteel to cut a Manasteel Gear.
technom.lexicon.techno_basics.2: A Mana Coil is mana-infused redstone.
technom.lexicon.techno_basics.3: A Manasteel Gear is the mechanical heart of every machine below.
technom.lexicon.flower_dynamo.1: The Hippie Dynamo drinks mana from every pool within four blocks on its own level, in any direction, and burns it into Forge Energy. It holds 100,000 mana and 40,000 Q.
technom.lexicon.flower_dynamo.2: It outputs 80 Q per tick, or 320 with a Potency Gem. Right-click the output face with a wrench, or sneak-right-click it empty-handed, to turn it; the other redstone-programming items set its redstone mode.
technom.lexicon.flower_dynamo.3: Three Manasteel Gears, two Manasteel Ingots, a Mana Coil and redstone.
technom.lexicon.mana_fabricator.1: The Mana Fabricator is itself a mana pool. Feed 1,000,000 Q into its one input face and it produces 100 mana, up to a pool of 100,000. A wrench turns the input face.
technom.lexicon.mana_fabricator.2: Two Manasteel Gears, two Manasteel Ingots, a Mana Diamond and an Eye of Ender.
technom.lexicon.processor_bo.1: The Botanical Purifier doubles an ore's output for mana instead of Ignis. It fills a 1,000,000 mana buffer from every pool in its 9x9 layer, up to 5,000 a tick.
technom.lexicon.processor_bo.2: One processing cycle is paid per working tick: 150 mana times the ore's stage, plus 1,500 for a re-processing pass.
technom.lexicon.processor_bo.3: A Mana Coil, Manasteel Ingots, Livingrock and redstone.
technom.lexicon.mana_exchanger.1: The Mana Exchanger turns mana into a fluid and back again. A mana pool must sit directly on top of it, where it is covered by the machine's overlay.
technom.lexicon.mana_exchanger.2: One operation costs 1,000 Q and moves either 1,000 mana from the pool into 1 bucket of mana fluid, or one bucket of fluid back into 1,000 mana. A wrench swaps the two directions.
technom.lexicon.mana_exchanger.3: Three Manasteel Ingots, two Livingrock, a Mana Pool, glass and a Mana Coil.
technom.lexicon.mana_exchanger.4: A bucket of mana fluid is made by infusing an empty bucket with 50,000 mana.
technom.jei.fuel.random: Plus a random bonus of 0 to %s
technom.jei.info.quantized_glass:
Decorative glass that shrugs off explosions.
A crafting material for the mod's machines and jars.
technom.jei.info.quantum_jar:
Stores one aspect at a time, with ten times the capacity of an ordinary jar.
Use it wherever a jar is called for and you need the extra room.
technom.jei.info.energy_condenser:
Converts Forge Energy into Potentia essentia, at 200,000 Q per unit and up to 8,192 Q/t.
It buffers 64 essentia and 100,000 Q.
Sneak-right-click a face to toggle it as an output, one face at a time; the front face can never output.
It runs whenever it is not receiving a redstone signal.
technom.jei.info.essentia_dynamo:
Burns essentia into Forge Energy: 80 Q/t, or 320 Q/t with a Potency Gem.
With the gem each charge costs four units instead of one.
It buffers 64 essentia and 40,000 Q, suction is 128, and output is capped at 320 Q/t.
Essentia enters any face but the one it faces, and only the face it points at outputs. What a unit is worth varies with biome, dimension and height; see the fuel page.
technom.jei.info.item_coil:
Wireless item transport: every tick it moves one slot, up to a full stack of 64, from each linked inventory into the block it faces.
Bind it to inventories with a Coil Coupler.
It supports a ghost filter to control what it moves.
technom.jei.info.essentia_coil:
Wireless essentia: every tick it pushes one unit from each linked block into the block it faces, and consumers can also pull from it in reverse.
Links reach 32 blocks on each axis, up to 16 links, and it supports an aspect filter.
With a Potency Gem it instead emits a redstone signal while its target still has room, and ignores redstone itself.
technom.jei.info.coil_coupler:
Binds both kinds of coil to the blocks they should draw from.
Right-click a coil to start binding, then right-click each source block to add a link.
Right-click a linked block again to remove it, or sneak-right-click the coil to clear every link.
Sneak-right-click the air to forget the coil you started from.
technom.jei.info.node_dynamo:
Burns Vis drawn from aura nodes and jarred nodes within four blocks into Forge Energy.
80 Q/t, or 320 Q/t with a Potency Gem; it buffers 40,000 Q and 16 Vis.
It draws one Vis every 21 ticks, each worth 30 fuel points.
Only the face it points at outputs energy, and it ignores redstone by default.
technom.jei.info.node_fabricator:
Two controllers, six blocks apart and facing each other, build a node three blocks along the facing and one above it; each needs a 3x3 plate of nine shells.
They buffer 50,000,000 Q and 256 essentia.
Charging a node costs 1,000 Q and one essentia per Vis; with a Potency Gem, 10,000 Q and ten essentia raise its base Vis by one.
With no node between them the pair draws auram and vitium, and once they hold more than 64 units a wand click begins a 200-tick creation ritual costing about ((auram+vitium)/2)^2 x 762.94 Q.
technom.jei.info.fusion_focus:
A wand focus for moving a node's Vis into another node.
Click a node to select it, free of charge, then click a second node to pour the first one's Vis into it.
Sneak-right-click a node to take the whole block into the focus, and right-click empty space to put it back.
Range is 12 blocks.
technom.jei.info.essentia_reservoir:
Stores 256 units of a single aspect.
All six faces both accept and provide it, with suction 128.
It actively pulls one unit per tick from each neighbouring container.
technom.jei.info.creative_jar:
A creative source of one chosen aspect.
It only gives, never accepts.
For testing and map making.
technom.jei.info.processor_tc:
Purifies ore and doubles the output, using only Ignis and no energy.
It buffers 64 Ignis with suction 128, one cycle every 60 ticks.
Each working tick costs max(1, stage + 2 x passes): a raw ore about 120 Ignis in all, a re-processing pass 300.
It only accepts essentia, never gives it out.
technom.jei.info.essentia_fusor:
Combines two aspects into one compound aspect.
Its four horizontal faces are slots; mark two as inputs and one as output with a filled or empty jar.
Each face buffers 64 units, input suction 48 and output -48, and energy enters any face but the top.
It buffers 2,000,000 Q and needs a redstone signal; a fusion costs max(1,000, the output's maximum fuel value x 80 x scale).
technom.jei.info.adv_decon_table:
Breaks one item down in its single slot over 80 ticks, or 40 with a Potency Gem.
It spreads the item's aspects into primal aspects.
There is a chance to yield one research point: rand(80) below the number of primals, then one in eight.
Points are credited to the player who placed it every 20 ticks, up to 32,767.
technom.jei.info.eldritch_consumer:
Eats mobs first, then dropped items, then a single block below it in range, storing their aspects.
Each object costs 20,000 Q from a 1,000,000 Q buffer.
It holds up to four aspects, 64 of each and 256 in total, with a 40-tick cooldown after a success.
Sneak-click to step through its ranges, from TINY up to GIGANTIC; it needs a redstone signal by default.
technom.jei.info.flux_lamp:
Calms a running infusion altar by burning Ordo to produce flux goo.
Each point of instability costs 5 Ordo, up to 5 points every 10 ticks.
Each point makes 200 mB of goo, into a 1,000 mB tank.
It holds 32 Ordo and searches a 21x10x21 volume; essentia enters through the top face only, suction 128.
technom.jei.info.electric_bellows:
Blows into the Thaumcraft furnace or a vanilla furnace in the one block it faces.
Each puff costs 3,000 Q from a 20,000 Q buffer.
A Thaumcraft furnace burns for 80 ticks; a vanilla furnace is given 80 ticks of progress, advancing one tick every two.
technom.jei.info.biome_morpher:
Rewrites the biome around it, one charge at a time.
Each 20,000 Q charge converts two columns, offset by rand(100) - rand(100), about 99 blocks either way; the buffer holds 800,000 Q.
It cycles between Magical Forest, Eerie and Tainted Land.
It runs while it is not receiving a redstone signal.
technom.jei.info.ritual_crystal:
Frame blocks for rituals, and they glow.
Stack one above another of the same colour and it densifies, narrowing through three stages.
A frame is three layers: squares of pillars at radius 1, 3 and 5, each pillar three crystals tall.
Each ritual demands particular colours on particular layers; the Ritual Tome has the shapes.
technom.jei.info.ritual_catalyst:
The core of a ritual; its colour picks the element: Earth, Fire, Water, Light or Dark.
Activate it by right-clicking, or with a rising redstone edge.
It cannot be broken while its ritual is running.
technom.jei.info.ritual_tome:
Right-click to open the ritual list.
Every ritual's shape and effect is written down inside.
technom.jei.info.pen:
The thaumaturge's writing tool, holding 3,000 ink.
Use it on two adjacent tables to fuse them into a research table, and it places itself inside.
technom.jei.info.existence_burner:
Kills non-player creatures within 3 blocks, a 7x7x7 volume, and turns them into Power of Existence.
It costs nothing to run and holds up to 100.
A villager is worth 15, a monster 1, anything else 2.
It runs while it is not receiving a redstone signal.
technom.jei.info.existence_dynamic_burne:
Kills non-player creatures within 3 blocks and turns them into Power of Existence, like the plain burner.
Each kill costs 10,000 Q from a 100,000 Q buffer, and energy enters through the bottom face only.
It holds up to 150.
A villager is worth 20, a monster 2, anything else 4.
technom.jei.info.existence_gem:
Carries a charge from 0 to 100.
Killing a villager adds 25, an animal 2, a monster 1, so a full gem is four villagers.
Hold it while a creature dies nearby to charge it.
technom.jei.info.existence_pylon:
Relays Power of Existence within a 15x15x3 volume.
Throughput is 5 for the basic pylon, 25 for the advanced and 125 for the complex one.
Place them between a source and whatever it feeds to carry the power across.
technom.jei.info.existence_crop_accelera:
Ripens crops in the 11x11 area above it, 30 power per growth stage.
It buffers 10,000 power, needs more than 605 to start, and moves at most 200 power per tick.
technom.jei.info.existence_harvester:
Harvests mature crops in the 11x11 area on its own level and replants them.
Each crop costs 30 power.
technom.jei.info.existence_sealer:
Marks villagers carrying a treasure within 3 blocks, so they can be made to drop it.
It costs 500,000 power from a 1,000,000 buffer, moving at most 20,000 power per tick.
The seal does not remove the treasure by itself.
technom.jei.info.existence_fountain:
Produces 500 power every tick, up to a 1,000,000 cap and 2,000 output per tick.
It is created by the Ritual of the Fountain of Existence, once that ritual has gathered 1,000 existence.
technom.jei.info.treasure_fire_gem:
A treasure carried by a villager.
While carried it grants fire resistance, and when its carrier is hit it puts the attacker out and sets them alight for 15 seconds.
If the carrier dies before the treasure is sealed, it explodes in a radius of 30 and sets fire within 25 blocks for 120 seconds.
Villagers only carry it if they spawned after the treasure option was enabled, roughly one in fifty.
technom.jei.info.treasure_power_plate:
A treasure carried by a villager.
While carried it grants resistance, and when its carrier is hit it grants Resistance V for one tick.
If the carrier dies before the treasure is sealed, it slows everything within 5 blocks and turns an 11x11x11 volume into obsidian.
Villagers only carry it if they spawned after the treasure option was enabled, roughly one in fifty.
technom.jei.info.treasure_golden_wing:
A treasure carried by a villager.
While carried it grants slow falling, and when its carrier is hit it launches the attacker away.
If the carrier dies before the treasure is sealed, it launches everything within 25 blocks.
Villagers only carry it if they spawned after the treasure option was enabled, roughly one in fifty.
technom.jei.info.flower_dynamo:
Burns mana into Forge Energy.
It holds 100,000 mana and 40,000 Q, drawing 100 mana from every mana pool on its own 9x9 level.
One mana is worth 640 Q, output capped at 320 Q/t.
technom.jei.info.mana_fabricator:
The reverse of the dynamo: a mana pool that runs on energy.
It holds 100,000 mana, producing 100 mana per 1,000,000 Q.
Energy enters through the single face it points at.
technom.jei.info.mana_exchanger:
Swaps 1,000 mana for 1,000 mB of mana fluid and back again.
A mana pool must sit directly on top of it.
Each operation costs 1,000 Q, from a 10,000 Q buffer, and the fluid tank holds 1,000 mB.
technom.jei.info.processor_bo:
Purifies ore for mana instead of Ignis.
It fills a 1,000,000 mana buffer from every pool on its 9x9 level, up to 5,000 mana per tick.
One cycle is 60 ticks; each working tick costs 150 mana times the stage, plus 1,500 for a re-processing pass.
technom.tome.page.ritual101.introduction: Rituals are weak summons of nature's power. They are easy to set up and don't cost too much in resources. Read on for how to make and use them.
Crystals form the frame, and the catalyst is the core. Place them as described in the following pages and trigger the catalyst by right-clicking it or with redstone.
technom.tome.page.ritual101.crystals.lef: Crystals form the frame of rituals. They hold enough power to emit light, and they densify naturally when placed above another one.
technom.tome.page.ritual101.catalysts.le: Catalysts are the core of a ritual. They set the main element it leans towards, and are triggered by right-click or by a redstone signal.

technom.tome.page.existence.introduction: All living beings spring from one source: Power of Existence. Each holds only a little, but gathered in one place it grows dangerous, so ways exist to keep it stable.
You have discovered that emeralds make a particularly good catalyst, storing a great deal of power. After some experiments you create a gem that can hold a small amount of existence.
technom.tome.page.existence.farming.left: You have found a way to gather existence into a single device. The power is drawn from nearby creatures, which kills them — the smarter the creature, the more power it holds.
technom.tome.page.existence.fountain.lef: The Birth of the Fountain turns the existence of nearby beings into a self-sustaining mass shaped like a cobblestone Graal, said to be the best form for holding such nonsense.
technom.tome.page.existence.pylons.left: Emeralds have proven a good way to move Power. Pylons naturally draw power from where it is highly focused and disperse it where it is not.
technom.tome.page.existence.better_farmi: Crops react in an interesting way to Power of Existence. This device uses that power to accelerate crop growth in an 11×11 area, and must be placed underneath the soil.
technom.tome.page.treasures.introduction: Lore found in a village library hints that some villagers show otherworldly traits. They look like ordinary villagers, yet display incredible capacities.
A special note reveals that the power comes from artifacts buried inside the existence mass of these villagers. You devise a way to extract them, and conclude that rituals are your best ally.
technom.tome.page.treasures.extraction.l: The Ritual of Extraction serves to extract artifacts from special villagers. It is quite unstable and may cause catastrophes if not used correctly.
technom.tome.page.treasures.protection.l: Now that you know how dangerous those villagers are, you build a device to seal their power. The Existence Sealing Device seals a villager who carries a treasure so it can be taken from them, at a great cost in Power of Existence.
